summary: Autohome Inc. filed a Form 6-K to disclose the adoption of its 2026 Share Incentive Plan approved by the board and compensation committee. The plan authorizes the issuance of up to 31,200,000 ordinary shares under incentive awards including share options to directors, employees, and consultants. No financial terms, pricing, or premium are provided. This is a routine equity incentive plan adoption, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing serves as a notice of plan establishment under foreign private issuer obligations, with no structural mechanics or regulatory clock beyond standard share issuance. What to watch: no risk-arb angle exists; this is an ordinary compensation arrangement.
